per-Attempt mount namespace exposing only the assigned workspace, runtime output, and bounded cache while hiding sibling workspaces and control roots
root-owned immutable bundles, Runner start evidence, stdout/stderr capture, and terminal results outside payload write authority
SQLite lifecycle migration v2 with atomic quota admission, investigation holds, digest-bound two-phase garbage collection, Artifact tombstones, online backup, and empty-root restore
evidence-digest-bound held-orphan inspection and remediation that does not terminate a reused unit with a different InvocationID
Windows-orchestrated full WSL kernel shutdown and five-scenario startup reconciliation without automatic redispatch
independent M7 HTTP MCP adapter preserving M6 Job/Attempt semantics and bounded model-visible responses
common Evidence Envelope with exact implementation revision, harness digests, observation digest, claims-not-made, independent recomputation, and tamper rejection
evidence: The final local matrix ran 10 successful commands and passed all frozen gates, including eight M6 systemd recovery journeys, four M7 hardening/remediation journeys, four lifecycle contracts, default/M6/M7/MCP tests, Runner build, and three strict Clippy profiles. M7 Dogfood executed 8 journeys with 40 model-visible calls, 17965 Context bytes, 1 repair round, zero fallback, disconnect recovery, cgroup cancellation, idempotent replay, and worker package validation. Twenty paired M6/M7 Shadow samples were semantically equivalent; overall medians were M6 635 ms and 1812 Context bytes versus M7 689 ms and 1808 Context bytes with equal calls and HTTP requests. A full WSL kernel restart changed boot ID, preserved Attempt count 5 to 5, produced the five expected recovery classifications, left one intentionally held orphan reservation, and detected no automatic redispatch. M7 Wire recorded 64 concurrent reads with unique trace identities; transport negative paths returned [401, 401, 403, 403, 413]. M6 2/4/8 compatibility concurrency retained unique Job identities, final-slot protection, and zero residual active capacity.
verification_result: M7 is eligible for continued bounded local hardened Dogfood and for closing the M0-M7 execution-migration series. The evidence does not authorize production routing, remote exposure, credentials, deployment, network access, push, merge, external side effects, multi-host scheduling, or unattended high-risk authority.
degraded_reasons: Only one full WSL kernel-restart matrix was executed; repeated-reboot and long-duration soak reliability remain unproven.
The static worker is one local identity; cross-workspace separation depends on the verified mount namespace and filesystem contract rather than per-Job operating-system identities.
The M7 hardened path was about 8.5 percent slower than M6 in the bounded twenty-pair Shadow matrix.
Toolchain projection, cache provenance, and build-supply-chain coverage remain narrow.
Backup and restore are local single-node mechanisms and do not establish disaster recovery or multi-host continuity.
Remote principal authentication, organization policy distribution, credentials, and network capability remain absent.
Repository document governance retains the same three historical violations that predate M7.
remaining_debt: Run repeated reboot, long-duration soak, disk-pressure, process-exhaustion, and state-growth evaluations before considering broader authority.
Define signed toolchain and cache provenance before exposing broader build ecosystems.
Design remote principal authentication and policy distribution as a separate post-M-series decision, not as an implicit M7 extension.
Keep production routing, Cloudflare exposure, credentials, network access, deployment, Git push/merge, and external side effects in separately authorized stages.
Resolve the three historical document-governance violations on the independent documentation line.

authorization.rationale: M7 remains feature-gated and localhost-only. It changes no production route, Cloudflare configuration, credential scope, network delegation, deployment, push, merge, or external side-effect authority.

next_bounded_action: Close the M0-M7 migration series, perform a stage-level postmortem, and pause capability expansion until a separate decision identifies one narrowly scoped next problem.

verification_results.summary: Ten commands passed; all frozen test, real-systemd, lifecycle, worker identity, Runner ownership, and cleanup gates passed.
Native Tasks, Artifact, recovery, cancellation, response budgets, 64 concurrent reads, and trace uniqueness passed.
Eight journeys passed with 40 calls, one repair, zero fallback, recovery, cancellation, replay, and worker package validation.
Twenty pairs were semantically equivalent; M7 median 689 ms remained within the frozen 20 percent overhead limit versus M6 635 ms.
Full WSL kernel restart produced the expected five scenario classifications with no new Attempt and no automatic redispatch.
M6 Wire, transport, eight Dogfood journeys, and 2/4/8 concurrency remained valid at the measured M7 implementation.
A modified Shadow summary was rejected with exit 1 before semantic gate evaluation.
M7 adds no document-registry violation; the checker reports the same three historical violations.
